questions.stem: How can a ruptured ectopic pregnancy present before surgery?
questions.answer: From haemodynamically normal to severe hypovolaemic shock

questions.stem: Which vascular access should be secured before surgery for a ruptured ectopic pregnancy?
options: No IV access until in theatre
One peripheral cannula in the foot

questions.stem: Which tests should be sent on arrival for a ruptured ectopic pregnancy?
What should be done if a ruptured ectopic patient is unstable before induction?
options: Delay induction until blood pressure recovers
Proceed alone and call for a porter
Get a second anaesthetist to help
Cancel surgery and send to ward

questions.stem: When should rapid sequence induction be given for a shocked ruptured ectopic pregnancy?
questions.answer: With the patient draped and the surgeon scrubbed and ready to operate

questions.stem: Which induction agent is a good choice for a ruptured ectopic pregnancy in shock?
What should be done for the patient during surgery for a ruptured ectopic pregnancy?
options: Cool the patient to reduce bleeding
